name: TF
summary: A joke, output-only esoteric language. The Esolang wiki puts it in the class total.

name: TF2LANG
summary: A joke, object-oriented, pseudonatural esoteric language. The Esolang wiki puts it in the class Turing complete. It has no implementation.

name: TFDL
summary: FOLDOC, the Free On-line Dictionary of Computing, lists it as a computer language.

name: TFLite
summary: A functional, declarative esoteric language. It has an implementation.

name: TFMG
summary: A queue-based, declarative, concurrent, thematic esoteric language. The Esolang wiki puts it in the class Turing complete. It has no implementation.
